item.title: Hong Kong gov’t to deregister 3 Apple Daily firms, list them as ‘prohibited organisations’
item.description: The Hong Kong government has begun the process to de-register three companies linked to the Apple Daily newspaper and list them as “prohibited organisations,” authorities have said. item.description: China’s top internet regulator said on Thursday it would launch a crackdown during the Lunar New Year holiday period to curb social media content it deemed problematic including any that fanned fears about getting married or having children.
